title: Enterprise Cloud & AI Vendor Procurement Policy

pages.content: Schedule TIER-PROC-302 defines commercial approval authority by Annual Contract Value (ACV). Contracts up to EUR 50,000 require Procurement Lead approval. Contracts between EUR 50,001 and EUR 250,000 require joint sign-off from the VP of Procurement and the Data Protection Officer (DPO). Any AI or cloud agreement exceeding EUR 250,000 ACV requires formal authorization from the Executive Tender Board.

Every commercial agreement with a foundation model or external inference provider must incorporate Clause CL-ZDR-09 (Mandatory Zero-Data-Retention). Under CL-ZDR-09, the vendor warrants that enterprise prompts, retrieved passages, and outputs are never used for model training or weight updates, and volatile inference buffers are wiped within 24 hours.

pages.section_heading: 3. Supplier Security Attestation & CycloneDX SBOM Requirement
pages.content: Prior to purchase order issuance, software vendors must submit a current SOC 2 Type II report or ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certificate alongside a machine-readable CycloneDX 1.6 Software Bill of Materials (SBOM). Artifacts with unresolved critical CVEs (CVSS >= 9.0) are blocked from procurement onboarding.
